description: Update the SEO meta for a post (partial: only the fields you give change; null deletes a field). Purges the post's page cache. Returns the post's full SEO meta.

advanced_robots.description: Advanced robots directives; other keys are dropped by the server. null deletes the stored value.

breadcrumb_title.description: Title used in breadcrumbs. null deletes the stored value.

canonical.description: Canonical URL. null deletes the stored value.

description.description: Meta description. null deletes the stored value.

focus_keywords.description: Focus keywords, max 5 (extra ones are dropped). null deletes the stored value.

og_description.description: Open Graph description. null deletes the stored value.

og_image.description: Open Graph image attachment ID. null deletes the stored value.

og_title.description: Open Graph title. null deletes the stored value.

pillar_content.description: Mark as pillar (cornerstone) content. null deletes the stored value.

robots.description: Robots directives, comma separated (e.g. "noindex,nofollow"). null deletes the stored value.

schema.description: Custom JSON-LD (object, array or JSON string); overrides schema_type. Invalid JSON is stored as []. null deletes the stored value.

schema_type.description: Schema type built from post data: BlogPosting, Article, NewsArticle, WebPage or Product. null deletes the stored value.

seo_score.description: Stored SEO score (0-100). null deletes the stored value.

software_app.description: Per-post SoftwareApplication schema: { enabled, name, applicationCategory, operatingSystem, description, url, offers: [{ name, price, priceCurrency, url, unitText, unitCode }] (max 20), aggregateRating }. Omitted enabled = true. null deletes the stored value.

title.description: SEO title (template tokens like %title%, %sep%, %sitename% allowed). null deletes the stored value.

twitter_card.description: Twitter card type; unset falls back to the default_twitter_card setting. null deletes the stored value.

twitter_description.description: Twitter description. null deletes the stored value.

twitter_image.description: Twitter image attachment ID. null deletes the stored value.

twitter_title.description: Twitter title. null deletes the stored value.

name: seo_update_post_seo
